days.title: Nifty and Bank Nifty Analysis for 31 Jul
days.chart:
NIFTY forming a small green candle. BANKNIFTY forming a dragonfly Doji with a rejection wick at bottom that normally means strength.
NIFTY weekly candle Marubozu. BANKNIFTY weekly candle bullish hammer.
NIFTY monthly candle - positive candle confirming the last month's Bullish Harami candle.
BANKNIFTY forming Doji after recovery
days.fiiStockData: FII bought 3600 Cr. Big buy figure last two days!
days.verdict: Market likely to go up further till a genuine reversal signal comes. There is gap at 25100, that could be one eventual target
days.trades: Still a buy on dips market. We may test today's gap once in coming days - that could be our long side entry opportunity. Still with bull put spreads of August end expiries as the trade

days.title: Nifty and Bank Nifty Analysis for 30 Jul
days.chart: Both indices gap up and sustained. NIFTY forming Bullish Marubozu. BANKNIFTY forming Doji
days.openInterest: NIFTY - 24200 and below is support. SENSEX - 77500 and below is support
days.pcr:
NIFTY - 0.9 around ATM and 1.2 overall
SENSEX - 1.1 around ATM and 1.8 overall (1.8 is overheated)
days.participantOptionsData: Wednesday's OI change - FII Pro Bullish, client bearish
days.fiiFuturesData:
FII bought 1700 Cr in futures.
FII short OI has dropped significantly in August compared to July
days.verdict:
Market looks strong - despite all that is happening in US-Iran front. But tomorrow we may not see massive strength unless the tensions resolve.
But Fed interest rate decision today could overshadow everything else. So event risk
days.trades: Still a buy on dips market. We may test today's gap once in coming days - that could be our long side entry opportunity. Still with bull put spreads of August end expiries as the trade

days.title: Nifty and Bank Nifty Analysis for 29 Jul
days.chart: Both indices flat with tiny Dojis. May be expiry management (iykyk). There is no suggestion of weakness in either
days.openInterest: SENSEX has some resistance at 77000 but if its gone, we have violent short covering
days.pcr: 1.1 overal and around the ATM in SENSEX - Strong
days.participantOptionsData: No meaning for change today due to expiry
days.fiiFuturesData: We cannot infer anything today as monthly futures expired. In 1-2 days we will know rollover status
days.fiiStockData: Cash buying is also not straight forward because there could be cash - fut arbitrage on expiry
days.verdict: Expect bullishness in the days ahead
days.trades: Bull Call spreads or bull put spreads for farther expiries. August likely to be Bullish

days.title: Nifty and Bank Nifty Analysis for 28 Jul
days.chart:
Both indices gapping up. NIFTY forming a small green candle after gap. BANKNIFTY forming a Doji Cross.
Monthly candles have turned around in the last week to become positive. Usually this is strength
days.openInterest: 24000 is a support. First real resistance at 24200. One risk - almost all put OI was written today. Sometimes this backfires and creates a weak expiry day
days.participantOptionsData: Monday's OI change - FII Bullish, client and pro Bearish
days.verdict: Expiry is a little tricky because of the last minute put writing. So no predictions for tomorrow's expiry. After tomorrow market likely headed much higher
days.trades: Bull Call spreads or bull put spreads for farther expiries. August likely to be Bullish

days.chart: Green Marubozu candles on both indices. NIFTY bounces from gap. Weekly candle red, but monthly candle can go either way
days.openInterest: 23800 and below had decent support. 24000 is a huge resistance though
days.pcr: 1 around ATM. 0.8 overall. Neutral to Bullish
days.participantOptionsData: Friday OI change - FII and Pro Bullish. Client Bearish
days.fiiStockData: FII sold nearly 4000 Cr in cash

days.title: Nifty and Bank Nifty Analysis for 24 Jul
days.chart:
Both indices showing weakness. NIFTY head towards 23600 zone where there is a gapfill. 
Last week's bullish engulfing candle invalidated in both indices. We have bearish Marubozu weekly candles in both indices. Monthly candles also turning
days.participantOptionsData: Thursday's change - FII bearish, Pro neutral, Client Bullish
days.verdict: High chance that NIFTY will test 23600 gap fill zone. If that holds, we might have a bounce. Else we are heading way lower, may be even below 23000
days.trades: Wait and watch the price action at 23600, and take a decision. There is a possibility of a bounce at 23600 zone because gap fill. We have to see if that bounce sustains or not
